pinyin: huàn tāng bù huàn yào —— lǎo yī tào
literal: change · broth · not · change · medicine — old · one · set
natural: Changing the broth but not the medicine

meaning.en: Only the outward form changes while the substance stays the same.
meaning.zh: 只换了汤，药还是原来的，比喻形式变了，内容依旧，还是老一套。

examples.zh: 这次改革只是换汤不换药，问题照旧。
examples.en: This reform is just old wine in new bottles; the problems remain.

examples.zh: 换汤不换药，新方案还是老一套。
examples.en: The new plan is the same old thing.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: hán xìn jiàng bīng —— duō duō yì shàn
literal: Han Xin · lead · troops — more · more · better
natural: Han Xin leading troops: the more the better

meaning.en: The more the better; there can never be too many.
meaning.zh: 汉代韩信带兵，越多越好，比喻越多越好。

examples.zh: 韩信将兵，多多益善，欢迎大家多提建议。
examples.en: The more the merrier; please give us lots of suggestions.

examples.zh: 对学外语来说，词汇是韩信将兵，多多益善。
examples.en: For language learning, you can't have too much vocabulary.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Han Xin, a general of the early Han, told Emperor Gaozu that the more troops he led the better (《史记·淮阴侯列传》).
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。韩信对汉高祖说自己带兵多多益善，见《史记·淮阴侯列传》。

pinyin: fēi é pū dēng —— zì qǔ miè wáng
literal: flying · moth · pounce on · lamp — self · bring · destruction
natural: A moth flying into a flame

meaning.en: To bring about one's own ruin.
meaning.zh: 飞蛾扑向灯火被烧死，比喻自己找死、自取灭亡。

examples.zh: 他明知有风险还去赌，简直是飞蛾扑灯。
examples.en: He knew the risk and still gambled; like a moth to a flame.

examples.zh: 飞蛾扑灯，这样做只会自取灭亡。
examples.en: Doing this will only bring about your own downfall.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 倒了五味瓶子——酸甜苦辣咸都有
pinyin: dào le wǔ wèi píng zi —— suān tián kǔ là xián dōu yǒu
variants: 打翻五味瓶——酸甜苦辣咸都有
literal: knock over · (particle) · five-flavour · bottle — sour · sweet · bitter · hot · salty · all · have
natural: Knocking over a bottle of the five flavours

meaning.en: Mixed feelings; a bit of everything.
meaning.zh: 五味瓶倒了，各种味道都有，比喻心中百感交集。

examples.zh: 毕业那天，我像倒了五味瓶子，什么滋味都有。
examples.en: On graduation day I felt a bit of everything.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她倒了五味瓶子似的，说不清是喜是悲。
examples.en: She couldn't tell if she was happy or sad.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米——大的欺负小的
pinyin: dà yú chī xiǎo yú, xiǎo yú chī xiā mǐ —— dà de qī fù xiǎo de
parts: 大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米
literal: big · fish · eat · small · fish, small · fish · eat · shrimp — big · (one) · bully · small · (one)
natural: Big fish eat small fish, small fish eat shrimp

meaning.en: The strong prey on the weak.
meaning.zh: 大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米，比喻强者欺负弱者。

examples.zh: 大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米，这样的竞争太不公平。
examples.en: The big prey on the small; such competition is unfair.

examples.zh: 市场上大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米，小公司很难生存。
examples.en: Big fish eat small fish in this market, and small firms struggle.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: chūn jiāng shuǐ nuǎn —— yā xiān zhī
literal: spring · river · water · warm — duck · first · know
natural: When the spring river warms, the ducks know first

meaning.en: Those closest to a situation notice changes first.
meaning.zh: 春天江水变暖，鸭子最先知道，比喻身处其中的人最先察觉变化。

equivalents: those on the spot know first

examples.zh: 春江水暖鸭先知，做生意的人最早感到行情变化。
examples.en: Traders are the first to feel a shift in the market.

examples.zh: 春江水暖——鸭先知，一线员工最清楚问题在哪。
examples.en: Frontline staff know best where the problems lie.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. It comes from Su Shi's line 春江水暖鸭先知 in a poem on a painting.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自苏轼题画诗“春江水暖鸭先知”。

text: 吹口哨过坟场——自己给自己壮胆
pinyin: chuī kǒu shào guò fén chǎng —— zì jǐ gěi zì jǐ zhuàng dǎn
literal: blow · whistle · pass · graveyard — self · for · self · strengthen · courage
natural: Whistling while passing a graveyard

meaning.en: Keeping one's own spirits up when afraid.
meaning.zh: 经过坟场吹口哨，是给自己壮胆，比喻心里害怕却强装镇定。

examples.zh: 他上台前大声说笑，像吹口哨过坟场。
examples.en: He joked loudly before going on stage, whistling in the dark.

examples.zh: 别吹口哨过坟场了，你明明很紧张。
examples.en: Stop whistling in the dark; you're clearly nervous.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: lǎo shǔ lā guī —— wú cóng xià shǒu
literal: mouse · drag · tortoise — no · where · start · hand
natural: A mouse trying to drag a tortoise

meaning.en: Not knowing where to begin.
meaning.zh: 老鼠想拖乌龟，龟壳滑溜无处下口，比喻不知从何入手。

examples.zh: 这个难题让他老鼠拉龟，无从下手。
examples.en: This problem left him not knowing where to start.

examples.zh: 面对一堆乱账，我真是老鼠拉龟。
examples.en: Faced with a pile of messy accounts, I can't get a grip.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 雷公打豆腐——专拣软的欺
pinyin: léi gōng dǎ dòu fu —— zhuān jiǎn ruǎn de qī
literal: Thunder God · strike · tofu — only · pick · soft · (one) · bully
natural: The Thunder God striking tofu

meaning.en: Picking on the weak.
meaning.zh: 雷公只打豆腐，比喻专挑软弱的人欺负。

examples.zh: 你雷公打豆腐，专拣软的欺，算什么本事？
examples.en: Picking on the weak; what kind of skill is that?

examples.zh: 他总是雷公打豆腐，只敢欺负新来的。
examples.en: He picks on the new ones only.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 老虎头上拍苍蝇——胆子不小
pinyin: lǎo hǔ tóu shàng pāi cāng yíng —— dǎn zi bù xiǎo
variants: 狮子头上捕苍蝇——好大胆
literal: tiger · head · on · swat · fly — courage · not · small
natural: Swatting a fly on a tiger's head

meaning.en: Very bold, even reckless.
meaning.zh: 在老虎头上拍苍蝇，胆子真大，比喻敢于冒犯厉害人物。

equivalents: beard the lion in his den

examples.zh: 你敢顶撞老板，真是老虎头上拍苍蝇，胆子不小。
examples.en: Daring to talk back to the boss; you've got some nerve.

examples.zh: 老虎头上拍苍蝇，他一点也不怕。
examples.en: He isn't afraid at all.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 旗杆上扎鸡毛——好大的胆（掸）子
pinyin: qí gān shàng zhā jī máo —— hǎo dà de dǎn (dǎn) zi
variants: 旗杆上绑鸡毛——好大的掸子
literal: flagpole · on · tie · chicken · feather — so · big · 's · gall (duster)
natural: Tying chicken feathers to a flagpole: a big duster

meaning.en: Extremely bold.
meaning.zh: 旗杆上扎鸡毛成了大掸子，谐“胆子”，比喻胆子极大。

examples.zh: 你敢当面骂他，旗杆上扎鸡毛，好大的胆子！
examples.en: To insult him to his face; what nerve!

examples.zh: 旗杆上扎鸡毛，他居然敢这么做。
examples.en: He actually dared to do that.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 掸子 (dǎnzi, feather duster) sounds like 胆子 (dǎnzi, nerve), so 好大的掸子 means 'what nerve'.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“掸子”与“胆子”同音，“好大的掸子”即“胆子好大”。

pinyin: mǎ yǐ hàn dà shù —— zì bù liàng lì
literal: ant · shake · big · tree — self · not · measure · strength
natural: An ant trying to shake a big tree

meaning.en: Overestimating one's own strength.
meaning.zh: 蚂蚁想摇动大树，比喻不自量力。

equivalents: bite off more than one can chew

examples.zh: 小公司想挑战行业巨头，蚂蚁撼大树，自不量力。
examples.en: A small firm taking on the giants is overreaching.

examples.zh: 蚂蚁撼大树，你这是自不量力啊。
examples.en: You're overestimating yourself.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: lǎo shǔ tiǎn māo bí zi —— zhǎo sǐ
literal: mouse · lick · cat · nose — seek · death
natural: A mouse licking a cat's nose

meaning.en: Asking for trouble; courting disaster.
meaning.zh: 老鼠去舔猫的鼻子，比喻自找死路。

examples.zh: 你去惹他，那是老鼠舔猫鼻子，自己找死。
examples.en: Provoking him is asking for trouble.

examples.zh: 老鼠舔猫鼻子，这不是找死吗？
examples.en: Isn't that just asking for it?

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: lǎo hǔ chī tiān —— nán xià zhǎo
literal: tiger · eat · sky — hard · to put down · claw
natural: A tiger trying to eat the sky: nowhere to sink its claws

meaning.en: A task so big that one cannot begin.
meaning.zh: 老虎想吃天，无处下爪，比喻事情太难或太大，无法着手。

equivalents: a task too big to tackle

examples.zh: 这么大的工程，真是老虎吃天，难下爪。
examples.en: A project this big; I don't know where to begin.

examples.zh: 老虎吃天，他一时想不出办法。
examples.en: He couldn't think of a way in.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: lǎo hǔ jiè zhū —— yǒu jiè wú huán
variants: 老虎借猪狗借骨——有借无还
literal: tiger · borrow · pig — have · borrow · no · return
natural: A tiger borrowing a pig

meaning.en: Borrowing something with no intention of returning it.
meaning.zh: 老虎借了猪就吃掉，比喻借了东西不还。

equivalents: a loan that never comes back

examples.zh: 他借钱就像老虎借猪，有借无还。
examples.en: When he borrows money, it never comes back.

examples.zh: 别借给他，老虎借猪，肯定不还。
examples.en: Don't lend to him; you'll never see it again.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 癞蛤蟆敲大鼓——自吹自擂
pinyin: lài há ma qiāo dà gǔ —— zì chuī zì léi
literal: toad · beat · big · drum — self · blow · self · drum
natural: A toad beating a big drum

meaning.en: Boasting about oneself.
meaning.zh: 癞蛤蟆敲鼓，自己鼓噪，比喻自我吹嘘。

examples.zh: 他整天癞蛤蟆敲大鼓，自吹自擂。
examples.en: He spends all day blowing his own trumpet.

examples.zh: 癞蛤蟆敲大鼓，别听他吹牛。
examples.en: Don't listen to his bragging.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: hóu zi de pì gu —— zuò bù zhù
literal: monkey · 's · bottom — sit · not · still
natural: A monkey's bottom: cannot sit still

meaning.en: Restless; unable to sit still.
meaning.zh: 猴子的屁股坐不住，比喻人好动，静不下来。

examples.zh: 这孩子猴子的屁股，一刻也坐不住。
examples.en: This child can't sit still for a moment.

examples.zh: 他是猴子的屁股——坐不住，上课总乱动。
examples.en: He's always fidgeting in class.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: hé shang dǎ jià —— zhuā bù dào biàn zi
literal: monk · fight — grab · not · get · pigtail
natural: Monks fighting: no pigtails to grab

meaning.en: No weak point or fault to seize on.
meaning.zh: 和尚没有辫子，打架时抓不到，比喻抓不到对方的把柄。

examples.zh: 他做事一向干净，和尚打架，谁也抓不到辫子。
examples.en: He's always clean; no one can find any fault.

examples.zh: 和尚打架——抓不到辫子，对手拿他没办法。
examples.en: His rivals can do nothing to him.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 黄鼠狼给鸡送礼——不怀好意
pinyin: huáng shǔ láng gěi jī sòng lǐ —— bù huái hǎo yì
literal: weasel · to · chicken · give · gift — not · harbour · good · intent
natural: A weasel bringing a chicken a gift

meaning.en: Having bad intentions behind a show of kindness.
meaning.zh: 黄鼠狼给鸡送礼，是为了吃鸡，比喻心怀不轨。

examples.zh: 他突然这么殷勤，黄鼠狼给鸡送礼，肯定没安好心。
examples.en: He's suddenly so attentive; he must be up to no good.

examples.zh: 黄鼠狼给鸡送礼，你要小心。
examples.en: A weasel bearing gifts for a chicken; be careful.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 孔夫子放屁——文（闻）气冲天
pinyin: kǒng fū zǐ fàng pì —— wén (wén) qì chōng tiān
literal: Confucius · break wind — literary (smell) · air · surge · sky
natural: Confucius breaking wind: a smell to high heaven

meaning.en: A pun on 文 (literary) and 闻 (smell): someone who stinks of pedantry.
meaning.zh: 双关：“文”谐“闻”，“文气冲天”既指臭气熏天，也讽刺人酸腐、书生气重。

examples.zh: 他满嘴之乎者也，真是孔夫子放屁，文气冲天。
examples.en: He speaks in archaic phrases; he reeks of pedantry.

examples.zh: 孔夫子放屁——文气冲天，听得人直起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.en: Listening to that pedantry makes my skin crawl.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 文气 (wénqì, scholarly air) sounds like 闻气 (wénqì, smell), so the line mocks a very bookish manner.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“文气”谐“闻气”，讽刺人书生气十足。

pinyin: là zhú —— bù diǎn bù liàng
literal: candle — not · light · not · bright
natural: A candle: it doesn't shine unless lit

meaning.en: Someone who needs prompting before understanding.
meaning.zh: 蜡烛不点就不亮，比喻人不提醒就不明白。

examples.zh: 他这人蜡烛，不点不亮，你得把话说明白。
examples.en: He needs things spelled out for him.

examples.zh: 蜡烛——不点不亮，不提醒他就想不到。
examples.en: He won't think of it unless reminded.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

pinyin: shǎ zi guò nián —— kàn gé bì
literal: fool · spend · New Year — watch · next door
natural: A fool celebrating New Year by watching the neighbours

meaning.en: Simply copying what others do.
meaning.zh: 傻子不会过年，只看邻居怎么过，比喻自己没主意，只会模仿别人。

examples.zh: 他做事总是傻子过年，看隔壁怎么做就怎么做。
examples.en: He just copies what everyone else does.

examples.zh: 傻子过年——看隔壁，没有自己的想法。
examples.en: Copying the neighbours with no ideas of his own.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 正月十五贴门神——晚了半月
pinyin: zhēng yuè shí wǔ tiē mén shén —— wǎn le bàn yuè
literal: first · month · fifteenth · paste · door god — late · (particle) · half · month
natural: Pasting door gods on the 15th of the first month

meaning.en: Too late by half a month.
meaning.zh: 门神应在除夕贴，正月十五才贴，晚了半个月，比喻错过时机。

examples.zh: 现在才道歉，正月十五贴门神，晚了半月。
examples.en: Apologising now is far too late.

examples.zh: 他这时候才想起来，正月十五贴门神。
examples.en: He only thought of it now, long after the time.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。
